title: 2025 Topps Series 1 - Stars of MLB - MIKE TROUT #SMLB-8 Los Angeles Angels
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2025 Topps Series 1 Mike Trout Stars of MLB card featuring the Los Angeles Angels is a highly sought-after sports trading card for baseball fans. This standard-sized card showcases the star player Mike Trout in the MLB league, manufactured by Topps in the United States. As part of the base set and insert variety, this English-language card is a must-have for collectors looking to add a piece of the 2025 baseball season to their collection. The card number SMLB-8 signifies its unique place within the series, making it a valuable addition for fans of the sport.
